content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms impose high fees and restrictive policies that can hinder your ability to sell digital products. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which accumulates significantly over time. In contrast, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, allowing you to retain more of your earnings. This infrastructure is built for creators who want to bypass these barriers and own their entire sales process. By utilizing a combination of free hosting and decentralized payment solutions, you can create a sustainable income stream that isn’t reliant on third-party platforms that may block your access.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin the deployment process, gather the essential tools and resources. You will need a digital product ready for sale, such as an ebook or course, and cryptocurrency for transactions. Set up a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your store. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Lastly, create a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency payments. This foundational setup ensures you have everything you need to build a fully operational online store that you control.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools in place, it's time to establish your payment and delivery pipeline. Start by integrating NOWPayments with your store to facilitate on-chain crypto transactions. This integration allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with instant payment verification. Next, use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, ensuring your digital products are automatically sent to customers after payment confirmation. Implement backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage orders efficiently. This setup streamlines the purchase process, providing a seamless experience for your customers.
NOWPayments significantly reduces transaction fees compared to traditional platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your store set up and your payment pipeline functioning, you’re ready to go live. Publish your store through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, making it accessible to your audience. Promote your products through social media or email marketing to drive traffic. Monitor your store closely as you process your first transactions. Ensure everything works smoothly, from payment confirmation to product delivery. With your infrastructure in place, you can confidently process sales and begin generating revenue from your digital products.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial sales, focus on scaling your operations. Consider expanding your product offerings to include more ebooks, courses, or digital assets. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that can enhance your store's functionality. Optimize your marketing strategies to reach a wider audience and increase sales volume. As your business grows, continue to refine your infrastructure, ensuring it meets the demands of your expanding customer base while maintaining low fees and complete ownership.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
You maintain full ownership and control over your digital products.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to dive deeper into setting up your store, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for deploying your own digital commerce stack. You can find all the essential products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I start selling digital products without relying on major platforms?
Begin by setting up your own store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare. Use NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring low fees and control over your sales.
What are the fees associated with selling using this infrastructure?
Using NOWPayments, you incur only a 0.5% fee on transactions, compared to higher fees like Gumroad's 10%. This difference significantly increases your retained earnings.
Can I automate product delivery after transactions?
Yes, by integrating Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 with backend logic from Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automatically deliver products once payment is confirmed.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept payments in various digital currencies with low transaction fees.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Yes, you will have access to a 30-day support period after deploying your stack, ensuring you can address any issues that arise during your initial sales.
Automated delivery enhances customer experience and boosts sales efficiency.
